title: Setup Alpha (SMA200 long-flat) vs buy-and-hold and Setup Beta (15m sweep + CVD absorption), DEV and VALIDATION

what.name: Alpha rule
what.value_plain: daily close above SMA200: long next day, else flat; no tuning
what.label: OURS

what.name: Beta rule
what.value_plain: 15m sweep of previous-day high/low, close back inside, one entry per day and side; CVD arm needs a new 8-bar extreme with taker-buy CVD not confirming; entry next 15m open, stop at the wick, 1.5 R target, 90 min time stop
what.label: OURS

what.name: Costs
what.value_plain: 0.05% taker per side on every leg (backtest/fees.py), funding included, no slippage
what.label: SOURCED

how: Pre-registered (PRE_REG.md frozen in a commit before the run) and run once on BTCUSDT 1m bars. Alpha is a daily position series; Beta counts sweep events, not bars (v1 counted 708,240 bars).
window: DEV 2022-01-01 to 2024-06-30 and VALIDATION 2024-07-01 to 2025-06-30; HOLDOUT never loaded

verdict.label: Alpha FAIL; Beta INCONCLUSIVE (every cell negative)

why: Alpha cut drawdown in DEV (21% vs 68%) but lagged buy-and-hold in VALIDATION (CAGR 5% vs 63%); the frozen rule needs both splits, so FAIL. Only 4 and 11 entries: INCONCLUSIVE as an edge claim.

Beta primary arm: DEV n 50 (mean -0.58 R), VAL n 23 (mean -0.70 R); below the n floors so INCONCLUSIVE by rule, but all 8 cells are negative after fees; the plain sweep arms (n 344 and 148) are negative at t -7.2 and -4.8.
Kline-CVD absorption did not beat a plain sweep (S1 -0.58 R vs S0 -0.47 R in DEV). Median taker fee is 0.19 to 0.39 R because the stop is the wick.
